You write one complete single-file HTML5 mini-game and store it with the `save_draft` tool.

Rules you cannot break:

- The page is one HTML document: doctype, `<html lang>` matching the plan's language, a viewport meta tag, inline `<style>` and classic inline `<script>` only.
- No network, no storage, no dialogs, no `eval`, no module scripts, no external URLs. Draw every visual in code.
- Include the `CARTRIDGE` helper from the bridge card exactly as written, and send the bridge events the type card requires, in the order it describes.
- Listen for host commands (`pause`, `resume`, `reset`) as the bridge card shows.

How to work:

- The plan and the cards you need are in the message. Call `get_card` only if you need a card that is not included.
- Write the whole page, then call `save_draft` once with the full HTML. Never send a partial page.
- When the message lists failed rules, call `load_draft` first, fix every listed rule in that draft, keep what already works, and save the whole page again with `save_draft`.
- After saving, reply with one short sentence. Do not paste the page into your reply; only the saved draft counts.

content.text:
## Plan

```json
{
  "title": "Trois Secondes",
  "slug": "trois-secondes",
  "lang": "fr",
  "gameType": "stage-clear",
  "loop": "À chaque tour, choisis la bonne case parmi celles affichées avant que le chrono de trois secondes ne s'écoule. Enchaîne les tours pour progresser ; une réponse trop lente ou fausse met fin à la partie.",
  "input": "tap-anywhere",
  "style": "chalkboard"
}
```

## Cards

### Card `bridge`

# Bridge

Games talk to the host only through `postMessage`. Paste this helper verbatim before any game code:

```js
const CARTRIDGE = {
  send(type, payload = {}) {
    window.parent.postMessage(
      { source: "cartridge", v: 1, type, payload },
      "*",
    );
  },
};
```

The helper must be named `CARTRIDGE` and must stamp `source: "cartridge"` and `v: 1` on every message. <!-- rule:E1-10 -->

## Game to host

| event   | payload                              | when                                 |
| ------- | ------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------ |
| `boot`  | `{ title, gameType, lang }`          | once, after the first frame is drawn |
| `start` | `{}`                                 | when play begins                     |
| `score` | `{ value }`, an integer of 0 or more | whenever the score changes           |
| `level` | `{ index }`, starting at 1, then +1  | on entering each level               |
| `end`   | `{ reason, value? }`                 | once per play-through                |

- Send `boot` with all three keys: `CARTRIDGE.send("boot", { title, gameType, lang })`. <!-- rule:E1-11 -->
- When `boot.lang` is written as a literal, it must equal the `lang` on `<html>`. <!-- rule:E1-12 -->
- Emit `CARTRIDGE.send("start")` when play begins. <!-- rule:E1-13 -->
- Write `boot.gameType` as a string literal naming one of the four game types; it must match the planned type. <!-- rule:E1-14 -->
- Pass `score.value` as a number, never a quoted string. <!-- rule:E1-18 -->
- Give every `level` call an `index` key: `CARTRIDGE.send("level", { index: stage })`. <!-- rule:E1-19 -->

## Host to game

Commands arrive as `{ source: "cartridge-host", type }` with `type` one of `pause`, `resume` or `reset`. Ignore anything with another `source`.

- Listen with `window.addEventListener("message", …)` and handle `pause` and `resume`: freeze and restart the loop without losing state. <!-- rule:E1-20 -->
- Handle `reset` by returning to the pre-`start` screen without reloading the page. <!-- rule:E1-21 -->

```js
window.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
  const data = event.data;
  if (!data || data.source !== "cartridge-host") return;
  if (data.type === "pause") paused = true;
  if (data.type === "resume") paused = false;
  if (data.type === "reset") backToTitle();
});
```

### Card `chalkboard`

# Chalkboard

The game looks sketched in chalk on a school slate.

## Palette

| role   | colour    |
| ------ | --------- |
| slate  | `#2f3e3a` |
| chalk  | `#eeeae0` |
| accent | `#f2c14e` |
| second | `#8fc1e3` |

## Primitives

- Stroked paths with `lineCap = "round"` and a line width of 3 to 5 pixels.
- Draw each stroke twice with a one-pixel offset and lower alpha for a dusty edge.
- Hatching (parallel short lines) instead of solid fills.
- A faint smudge layer: a few large, very transparent chalk-coloured ellipses behind the play field.

## Avoid

- Solid filled shapes larger than a thumb.
- Perfectly straight machine lines; add a small wobble.
- More than two accent colours on screen at once.

### Card `game-page`

# Game page

A cartridge is one self-contained HTML file. The host loads it into a sandboxed iframe with scripts allowed and no same-origin access.

## Document

- Start with a single `<!doctype html>` and wrap everything in one `<html>…</html>`. Never embed another `<iframe>`. <!-- rule:E1-01 -->
- Put the UI language on the root element, for example `<html lang="fr">`: a two- or three-letter primary subtag with an optional region. <!-- rule:E1-03 -->
- Add `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">` in the head. <!-- rule:E1-04 -->

## Self-contained

- Load nothing from outside the file: no `http:`, `https:` or `//` URL in `src`, `href`, CSS `url()`, `@import` or `import()`. Inline `data:` URIs are fine. <!-- rule:E1-02 -->
- Draw every sprite, tile and glyph in code (canvas paths or inline SVG). Use system fonts.

## Forbidden APIs

- Do not open a network connection: no `fetch(`, `XMLHttpRequest`, `WebSocket`, `EventSource` or `sendBeacon`. <!-- rule:E1-05 -->
- Do not persist anything: `localStorage`, `sessionStorage`, `indexedDB` and `document.cookie` all throw inside the sandbox. <!-- rule:E1-06 -->
- Do not build code at runtime: no `eval(`, no `new Function(`, and pass functions, not strings, to `setTimeout` and `setInterval`. <!-- rule:E1-07 -->
- Avoid blocking dialogs (`alert(`, `confirm(`, `prompt(`); draw messages on the canvas instead. <!-- rule:E1-08 -->

## Scripts

- Use classic inline `<script>` blocks only, never `type="module"`, and make sure each one parses on its own. <!-- rule:E1-09 -->
- Keep one script for the bridge helper and one for the game, or merge them. Order matters: the helper must exist first.

## Layout

- Fill the viewport and react when it changes: listen for `resize`, read `innerWidth`/`innerHeight`, or size with `dvh`/`vw` units. <!-- rule:E1-23 -->
- Scale the canvas by `devicePixelRatio` so lines stay crisp on phones.
- Keep touch targets at least 44 CSS pixels on the short edge.

### Card `stage-clear`

# Stage clear

The player meets a stated goal to clear each stage. Clearing the last stage wins; failing a stage loses.

## Contract row

| field                | value         |
| -------------------- | ------------- |
| score                | `optional`    |
| level                | `required`    |
| end                  | `required`    |
| end reasons          | `win, lose`   |
| reset                | `soft`        |
| idle death gate      | `min-seconds` |
| idle motion required | `yes`         |

- Emit every event marked `required` above: a `level` on entering each stage and an `end` when the play-through finishes. <!-- rule:E1-15 -->
- Never emit an event marked `forbidden` in the row above. <!-- rule:E1-16 -->
- Use only `win` or `lose` as the `end` reason. <!-- rule:E1-17 -->

## Stages

Number stages from 1 and step by one. Show the goal on screen when each stage opens ("Light 5 lamps"). Make stage 1 easy enough to clear on the first try.

## Loop skeleton

```js
let stage = 0;
function enterStage(next) {
  stage = next;
  buildStage(stage);
  CARTRIDGE.send("level", { index: stage });
}
function onGoalMet() {
  if (stage === STAGES.length) CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "win" });
  else enterStage(stage + 1);
}
function onStageFailed() {
  CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "lose" });
}
```

Give the player a few seconds of grace at the start of each stage before any threat can finish it.

### Card `tap-anywhere`

# Tap anywhere

The whole screen is the button. Best for jumps, flaps and single choices.

- Register pointer input on the canvas: `canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", onTap)`. <!-- rule:E1-22 -->
- Call `event.preventDefault()` and set `touch-action: none` on the canvas so the page does not scroll or zoom.
- The first tap after `boot` starts play and sends `start`; later taps perform the action.
- Ignore taps while paused.

```js
canvas.style.touchAction = "none";
canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
  event.preventDefault();
  if (paused) return;
  if (!running) {
    running = true;
    CARTRIDGE.send("start");
    return;
  }
  act();
});
```

Show a short pulsing hint ("Tap to begin") until the first tap.

## Task

Write the complete game page for this plan and save it with `save_draft`.
I'll build this game now - a chalkboard-styled reaction game where players tap the correct highlighted cell before a 3-second timer runs out.

input.html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="fr">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Trois Secondes</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%;
    background: #2f3e3a;
    overflow: hidden;
    font-family: "Comic Sans MS", "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  }
  canvas {
    display: block;
    touch-action: none;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<script>
// ---- Bridge helper (verbatim) ----
const CARTRIDGE = {
  send(type, payload = {}) {
    window.parent.postMessage(
      { source: "cartridge", v: 1, type, payload },
      "*",
    );
  },
};

window.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
  const data = event.data;
  if (!data || data.source !== "cartridge-host") return;
  if (data.type === "pause") paused = true;
  if (data.type === "resume") paused = false;
  if (data.type === "reset") backToTitle();
});

// ---- Setup canvas ----
const canvas = document.getElementById("game");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
canvas.style.touchAction = "none";

let dpr = Math.max(1, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
let W = 0, H = 0;

function resize() {
  W = window.innerWidth;
  H = window.innerHeight;
  dpr = Math.max(1, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
  canvas.width = Math.round(W * dpr);
  canvas.height = Math.round(H * dpr);
  canvas.style.width = W + "px";
  canvas.style.height = H + "px";
  ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
}
window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
resize();

// ---- Palette ----
const COL_SLATE = "#2f3e3a";
const COL_CHALK = "#eeeae0";
const COL_ACCENT = "#f2c14e";
const COL_SECOND = "#8fc1e3";

// ---- Chalk drawing helpers ----
function wobble(amount) {
  return (Math.random() - 0.5) * amount;
}

function chalkLine(x1, y1, x2, y2, color, width) {
  ctx.lineCap = "round";
  ctx.lineJoin = "round";
  for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
    const ox = wobble(1.2);
    const oy = wobble(1.2);
    ctx.globalAlpha = i === 0 ? 0.85 : 0.35;
    ctx.strokeStyle = color;
    ctx.lineWidth = width;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x1 + ox + wobble(1.5), y1 + oy + wobble(1.5));
    ctx.lineTo(x2 + ox + wobble(1.5), y2 + oy + wobble(1.5));
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function chalkRect(x, y, w, h, color, width) {
  chalkLine(x, y, x + w, y, color, width);
  chalkLine(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, color, width);
  chalkLine(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, color, width);
  chalkLine(x, y + h, x, y, color, width);
}

function chalkHatchFill(x, y, w, h, color, spacing) {
  spacing = spacing || 8;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.rect(x, y, w, h);
  ctx.clip();
  for (let i = -h; i < w + h; i += spacing) {
    chalkLine(x + i, y, x + i - h, y + h, color, 2.5);
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function chalkCircle(cx, cy, r, color, width) {
  ctx.lineCap = "round";
  for (let pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = pass === 0 ? 0.85 : 0.35;
    ctx.strokeStyle = color;
    ctx.lineWidth = width;
    ctx.beginPath();
    const segs = 24;
    for (let i = 0; i <= segs; i++) {
      const a = (i / segs) * Math.PI * 2;
      const rr = r + wobble(1.5);
      const px = cx + Math.cos(a) * rr + wobble(1);
      const py = cy + Math.sin(a) * rr + wobble(1);
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py);
      else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function chalkText(text, x, y, size, color, align) {
  ctx.font = `${size}px "Comic Sans MS", cursive, sans-serif`;
  ctx.textAlign = align || "center";
  ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.fillText(text, x + wobble(0.6), y + wobble(0.6));
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.4;
  ctx.fillText(text, x + wobble(1) + 1, y + wobble(1) + 1);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

// ---- Smudge layer ----
let smudges = [];
function initSmudges() {
  smudges = [];
  const n = 5;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    smudges.push({
      x: Math.random() * W,
      y: Math.random() * H,
      r: 80 + Math.random() * 160,
      a: 0.02 + Math.random() * 0.04,
    });
  }
}
function drawSmudges() {
  for (const s of smudges) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.fillStyle = COL_CHALK;
    ctx.globalAlpha = s.a;
    ctx.ellipse(s.x, s.y, s.r, s.r * 0.6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
}

// ---- Game state ----
let paused = false;
let running = false; // becomes true after first tap (start)
let gameOver = false;
let stage = 0;
let score = 0;
let cells = []; // grid cells for current stage
let gridCols = 2, gridRows = 2;
let targetIndex = -1;
let stageStartTime = 0;
let timeLimit = 3000; // ms
let graceMs = 900; // grace period before threat can end stage
let stageDeadlineActive = false;
let flashTimer = 0;
let flashColor = null;
let resultMessage = "";
let lastFrameTime = 0;

const MAX_STAGE_FOR_GRID = 20;

function backToTitle() {
  running = false;
  gameOver = false;
  stage = 0;
  score = 0;
  paused = false;
  resultMessage = "";
}

function gridSizeForStage(s) {
  // stage 1: 2x2, grows slowly
  if (s <= 1) return { cols: 2, rows: 2 };
  if (s <= 3) return { cols: 2, rows: 3 };
  if (s <= 6) return { cols: 3, rows: 3 };
  if (s <= 10) return { cols: 3, rows: 4 };
  return { cols: 4, rows: 4 };
}

function timeLimitForStage(s) {
  // always "3 seconds" per plan loop, keep constant but shrink slightly at higher stages, floor at 1.4s
  const t = 3000 - (s - 1) * 80;
  return Math.max(1400, t);
}

function buildStage(s) {
  const size = gridSizeForStage(s);
  gridCols = size.cols;
  gridRows = size.rows;
  const total = gridCols * gridRows;
  targetIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * total);
  cells = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < total; i++) {
    cells.push({ hit: false });
  }
  timeLimit = timeLimitForStage(s);
  stageStartTime = performance.now();
  stageDeadlineActive = false;
  // grace period before threat becomes active
  setTimeout(() => {
    if (!gameOver && running) stageDeadlineActive = true;
  }, graceMs);
}

function enterStage(next) {
  stage = next;
  buildStage(stage);
  CARTRIDGE.send("level", { index: stage });
}

function onGoalMet() {
  score += 1;
  CARTRIDGE.send("score", { value: score });
  flashColor = COL_SECOND;
  flashTimer = 250;
  enterStage(stage + 1);
}

function onStageFailed(reason) {
  gameOver = true;
  running = false;
  resultMessage = reason;
  flashColor = "#c96a5a";
  flashTimer = 400;
  CARTRIDGE.send("end", { reason: "lose" });
}

function layoutCellRects() {
  const margin = 40;
  const topPad = 140;
  const areaW = W - margin * 2;
  const areaH = H - topPad - margin;
  const gap = 12;
  const cw = (areaW - gap * (gridCols - 1)) / gridCols;
  const ch = (areaH - gap * (gridRows - 1)) / gridRows;
  const size = Math.min(cw, ch);
  const totalW = size * gridCols + gap * (gridCols - 1);
  const totalH = size * gridRows + gap * (gridRows - 1);
  const startX = margin + (areaW - totalW) / 2;
  const startY = topPad + (areaH - totalH) / 2;
  const rects = [];
  for (let r = 0; r < gridRows; r++) {
    for (let c = 0; c < gridCols; c++) {
      rects.push({
        x: startX + c * (size + gap),
        y: startY + r * (size + gap),
        w: size,
        h: size,
      });
    }
  }
  return rects;
}

function hitTestCell(px, py) {
  const rects = layoutCellRects();
  for (let i = 0; i < rects.length; i++) {
    const r = rects[i];
    if (px >= r.x && px <= r.x + r.w && py >= r.y && py <= r.y + r.h) {
      return i;
    }
  }
  return -1;
}

// ---- Input ----
canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", (event) => {
  event.preventDefault();
  if (paused) return;
  if (!running && !gameOver) {
    running = true;
    CARTRIDGE.send("start");
    enterStage(1);
    return;
  }
  if (gameOver) {
    // tap to restart to title (soft reset behavior via tap)
    backToTitle();
    return;
  }
  if (!running) return;
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const px = event.clientX - rect.left;
  const py = event.clientY - rect.top;
  const idx = hitTestCell(px, py);
  if (idx === -1) return;
  if (idx === targetIndex) {
    onGoalMet();
  } else {
    onStageFailed("wrong");
  }
});

// ---- Draw functions ----
function drawTitleScreen(t) {
  drawSmudges();
  chalkText("Trois Secondes", W / 2, H / 2 - 60, Math.min(48, W / 10), COL_CHALK);
  const pulse = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(t / 300);
  ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
  chalkText("Touche l'écran pour commencer", W / 2, H / 2 + 20, Math.min(24, W / 20), COL_ACCENT);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  chalkText("Trouve la bonne case avant la fin du temps !", W / 2, H / 2 + 70, Math.min(18, W / 26), COL_SECOND);
}

function drawGameOverScreen() {
  drawSmudges();
  chalkText("Partie terminée", W / 2, H / 2 - 60, Math.min(44, W / 11), COL_CHALK);
  chalkText("Score : " + score, W / 2, H / 2 + 0, Math.min(30, W / 15), COL_ACCENT);
  chalkText("Touche l'écran pour revenir", W / 2, H / 2 + 60, Math.min(20, W / 22), COL_SECOND);
}

function drawStage(t) {
  drawSmudges();

  // Header
  chalkText(`Étage ${stage}`, W / 2, 45, Math.min(32, W / 14), COL_CHALK);
  chalkText("Trouve la case marquée !", W / 2, 85, Math.min(20, W / 24), COL_SECOND);

  // Timer bar
  const elapsed = performance.now() - stageStartTime;
  const remaining = Math.max(0, timeLimit - Math.max(0, elapsed - graceMs));
  const frac = stageDeadlineActive ? remaining / timeLimit : 1;
  const barW = Math.min(420, W - 80);
  const barX = W / 2 - barW / 2;
  const barY = 105;
  chalkRect(barX, barY, barW, 14, COL_CHALK, 3);
  const fillColor = frac < 0.3 ? "#c96a5a" : COL_ACCENT;
  chalkHatchFill(barX + 2, barY + 2, Math.max(0, (barW - 4) * frac), 10, fillColor, 6);

  // Score
  chalkText("Score : " + score, W - 20, 30, 18, COL_CHALK, "right");

  // Grid
  const rects = layoutCellRects();
  for (let i = 0; i < rects.length; i++) {
    const r = rects[i];
    const isTarget = i === targetIndex;
    if (isTarget) {
      chalkHatchFill(r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, COL_ACCENT, 10);
      chalkRect(r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, COL_ACCENT, 4);
    } else {
      chalkRect(r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h, COL_CHALK, 3);
    }
  }

  // Check stage failure by timeout
  if (stageDeadlineActive && remaining <= 0 && !gameOver) {
    onStageFailed("timeout");
  }
}

function drawFlash(dt) {
  if (flashTimer > 0 && flashColor) {
    flashTimer -= dt;
    const alpha = Math.max(0, Math.min(0.35, flashTimer / 400 * 0.35));
    ctx.fillStyle = flashColor;
    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
}

// ---- Main loop ----
function frame(t) {
  if (!lastFrameTime) lastFrameTime = t;
  const dt = t - lastFrameTime;
  lastFrameTime = t;

  ctx.fillStyle = COL_SLATE;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  if (paused) {
    drawSmudges();
    chalkText("Pause", W / 2, H / 2, 40, COL_CHALK);
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    return;
  }

  if (!running && !gameOver) {
    drawTitleScreen(t);
  } else if (gameOver) {
    drawGameOverScreen();
  } else {
    drawStage(t);
  }

  drawFlash(dt);

  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}

// ---- Boot ----
initSmudges();
window.addEventListener("resize", initSmudges);

requestAnimationFrame((t) => {
  lastFrameTime = t;
  ctx.fillStyle = COL_SLATE;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  drawTitleScreen(t);
  CARTRIDGE.send("boot", { title: "Trois Secondes", gameType: "stage-clear", lang: "fr" });
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

tools.name: get_card
tools.description: Read one knowledge card by id.

tools.name: load_draft
tools.description: Load the newest saved draft of the game page, or null if none exists yet.

tools.name: save_draft
tools.description: Save the complete game page (one HTML document). Saving again in the same attempt replaces it.
